title: Estimation, Comparison, and Projection of Multifactor Age-Cohort Affine Mortality Models
query: How do different continuous-time affine mortality models—including the canonical Blackburn-Sherris, arbitrage-free Nelson-Siegel, and Cox-Ingersoll-Ross specifications—compare in terms of fitting performance, parameter estimation robustness, and out-of-sample cohort survival projection across multiple countries?
